objective: Frozen computation: exact infinite-plane correlations on the weave (honeycomb dimer kernel) and chain grids l = 1, 2, 3 (Kac-Ward resolvent), read as count outlines; and a census of every base reachable from the line of three by admitted extensions with up to three betweenness knots, asking whether the distinction-side ball profile, with or without N, and the state-side profile determine the number of orders k and the lattice dimension.
title: Exact outlines and the orders census
